posts.author: OpenTangent
posts.body: I use the VE_TilePriority plugin to correctly handle the z-index of tiles when players or events pass in front of or behind them. All tiles that need to be handled by this plugin must be marked with a "Counter" tag. This has the undesirable behavior of turning those tiles into countertops so now the player can, for example, open some chests at a distance. I can recreate the counter tag behavior by using Yanfly's Hitbox Resize plugin, so I just need the default Counter tag behavior disabled.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
you can change the "counter" ID to something else, but you can also
make a condition on the chest itself to be in front of it of 1 tile, not able
from the side or easier, if the player is ON region ID x.
this way, you have more control and it cannot be opened on a distance as
you can set an else handler on it "to far to open it" or something like that
or nothing.
but that would be the easiest work around if your comfortable with it.
